invariant_bindings.invariant_text: The returned `list[BatchItemResult]` MUST be the same length as the input `items` list and aligned by index (result[i] corresponds to items[i]).
In `all_or_nothing` mode, the FIRST item with status_code >= 400 MUST stop subsequent processing; all remaining items receive a 409 rollback placeholder.
In parallel strategy, concurrency MUST be bounded by `max_parallel` — the semaphore acquires at most that many permits simultaneously.
